tour.locked: Sign in to open this one — it reads your own data.
tour.launch_caption: Walks through every feature and where it lives, and tells you what changed in the latest release.
tour.finished: Tour finished — reopen it any time from Profile.
tour.news_intro: Shipped since you were last here.
tour.welcome_body: TopStocks turns a broker statement into your real numbers: FIFO lots, P/L in your own currency at the ECB rate of each trade's own date, and what your tax office will want. This tour walks through each feature, says whether your account has it switched on, and takes you to it. Two minutes, and you can leave and come back at any point.
tour.import_body: Drop a statement: every row is parsed and previewed before anything is written to your ledger. Revolut (CSV and PDF), Revolut crypto, Trading 212, DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, ClickTrade / Saxo and a generic CSV are recognised, and re-importing the same statement never duplicates a row. No statement to hand yet? **Load an example statement** puts a real one through the same parse, preview and commit, and **Clear last import** takes it back out again. Not ready to hand over a real statement? **Use demo transactions** on the Portfolio page fills the ledger with a made-up book of seven well-known stocks so every tab has something in it; it is labelled as demo wherever it shows, and your first real import deletes it. Everything else in the app — positions, P/L, allocation, tax, dividends, fees — derives from this one ledger.
tour.bank_body: Read-only access to your bank account through Enable Banking, so the cash side of your book isn't typed by hand. The connection is per account and expires the way your bank makes it expire; you re-consent from this page.
tour.positions_body: Your open lots with live prices, market value and weight in your reporting currency, plus which broker each holding actually sits in — a ticker split across two custodians shows as a split. Every ticker cell links through to its full page.
tour.risk_body: Two different questions, two sections. **Real return** is what your book actually did: time-weighted return (flow-adjusted, so a deposit never reads as a gain), money-weighted return (IRR), volatility and worst drawdown. **Risk of the current basket** is about what you hold today — allocation by sector, geography, currency and broker.
tour.tax_body: Sales matched against your lots — FIFO, LIFO, average cost or UK S104, whichever your country uses — realized gains per year net of commissions, and your jurisdiction's own rules on top. Ten are implemented (ES, US, UK, DE, FR, IT, IE, PT, CA, AU), each with its own brackets, allowances, reporting flags and reporting currency. Set your tax residence in Profile: it decides which rules run and which currency the ledger is replayed in.
tour.income_body: Dividends per year and per position, with withholding and the credit you can claim. The **Fees** tab then separates what the broker charged from what the spread cost you: each execution is measured against the midpoint of its own session, so the markup that never appears on a statement becomes a number.
tour.pulse_body: Where the market is heading, read against your own book. **Risk appetite** is a 0-100 score built from seven readings — trend, breadth, volatility, credit, stocks-versus-bonds, junk demand and emerging markets — with each one's contribution printed underneath and a tick showing where it stood a month ago, so the number is auditable rather than a black box. Almost every row on the page is the same shape: the level, the change over 1w / 1m / 3m / 12m, a sparkline, and whether the series is in an uptrend or turning. That is the design — a 10-year yield at 4.79% is a fact, and "+33bp over three months while the curve went nowhere" is the reading. **Trend snapshot** adds four things that only exist as trends: how many indices and sectors are actually above their own trend, the stock/bond correlation (positive means both legs fall together), and which of the four rates regimes the last quarter describes. Once you have imported a ledger, **what this means for your portfolio** measures your basket's own sensitivity to equities, rates, credit and the dollar — and how much each of those has drifted in the last quarter, which is the regime moving under you without your having traded.
tour.market_body: Price and chart with a zoom range that reports the move over exactly the window you selected, plus financials, estimates, insider activity and news. Every KPI carries where it came from: **Fact** is verifiable in a filing, **Consensus** is analyst estimates, **Derived** is computed here. The search box at the top of the page works from anywhere in the app. **Analyze with AI** in the header hands the whole company to the assistant — one click asks it about the business, the fundamentals, the valuation against its own history and how the position fits your book (funds and coins get their own question).
tour.screener_body: Filter the market on the metrics you care about, and see which of your holdings and watchlist names report next — with the result itself, surprise and reaction, once it lands.
tour.assistant_body: The chat panel on the right, reachable from every page, with your real book in hand: it reads your positions, live quotes, filings and the web, keeps long-term memory across conversations, and picks the analysis skill that fits the question. An empty thread opens with a few suggestions built from your own watchlist, so it has something useful to say before you have imported anything. It runs keyless on the shared TopStocks chain within a daily cap; connect your own provider key for no cap and your choice of model.
tour.notify_body: A portfolio digest in the evening and price alerts during market hours, on Telegram. Link your account once from the Notifications tab and the toggles start working; the jobs run server-side, so nothing depends on you having the app open.
tour.investor_body: Risk tolerance, horizon, focus and constraints. The assistant reads it before answering, so the analysis is framed for your mandate instead of a generic one. The **focus** areas do one more thing: the watchlist tab then offers example tickers from them that you do not already follow — examples to look at, never recommendations, and adding them removes nothing you have.
tour.prefs_body: Reporting currency, language, tax residence and the bracket inputs your jurisdiction reads, grouped into three cards; the tax card states what the choice decides (cost currency, share matching, tax year) instead of describing it. Nothing here has a Save button — every change is written as you make it. It is also where the ledger exports to CSV, where an account deletes itself, and where this tour lives whenever you want it again.
tour.news_2026_09_tax: **Tax in ten jurisdictions.** ES, US, UK, DE, FR, IT, IE, PT, CA and AU, each with its own lot matching, brackets and reporting flags — pick your residence in Profile. Positions also record which broker holds them now.
tour.news_2026_09_bank: **Bank connection.** Read-only access to your bank through Enable Banking, where it is enabled for your account.
tour.news_2026_09_chat: **A sharper assistant.** It now decides what to gather before it answers, and remembers across conversations.
tour.news_2026_09_askai: **Analyze with AI.** Any ticker's header now carries an Analyze with AI button: it opens the assistant with a full question about that company — business, fundamentals, valuation against its own history, risks and fit with your book — already asked.
tour.news_2026_09_fees: **Fees tab.** Commissions and estimated spread per broker — the execution cost your statement never itemises.
tour.news_2026_09_demo: **Demo transactions.** The Portfolio page can now fill itself with a made-up book of seven well-known stocks, so you can see positions, risk, dividends, fees and the tax report working before importing anything — your first real import removes it.
tour.daily_body: One AI card at the top of Home, generated once a day (it turns over at 09:00 in your own timezone): a headline and three or four lines on what to look at today — the day's move, the name that drove it, a print due this week, a position sitting at a 52-week edge. It reads the numbers the page already computed, and if no model answers it falls back to the same facts without the prose.
tour.news_2026_09_daily: **Daily action card.** One AI briefing a day on the dashboard, on the numbers Home already has — no prompt to write.
tour.news_2026_09_pulse: **Market pulse.** A new page built around direction rather than level: a 0-100 risk-appetite score with its seven inputs, every rate, index and gauge with its 1w/1m/3m/12m change, a sparkline and a trend label, trend breadth, the stock/bond correlation, the rates regime, inflation momentum by country, and your own basket's sensitivities and how they have drifted.
tour.news_2026_09_profile: **Profile, rebuilt.** Every setting is a row with its own explanation, grouped into Interface, Tax residence and Data — the tax card now states the rules your jurisdiction actually applies, and the whole ledger exports as CSV.
